name: User offboarding (safe)
description: Remove a person's access without destroying their work: sessions killed, content reassigned, role downgraded or user deleted with explicit reassignment targets.

params.name: reassign_to
params.description: User id that inherits the authored content when deleting.

steps.title: Identify
steps.detail: Call wp_get_user (id=<user_id>) and wp_list_user_sessions for the account: confirm identity, role, last activity and the number of active sessions.

steps.title: Inventory their work
steps.detail: Call wp_list_posts (author=<user_id>, per_page=100) and report counts by status; list media authored via wp_list_media if the owner asks.

steps.title: Kill sessions
steps.detail: With confirmation, call wp_destroy_user_sessions for the account: access is gone immediately, content untouched.

steps.title: Downgrade or delete
steps.detail: Preferred: call wp_update_user to set the role to subscriber (reversible). Only with explicit owner instruction AND a reassign target, call wp_delete_user (reassign_posts=<reassign_to>): the tool refuses last-admin and refuses to orphan content.

steps.title: Report
steps.detail: Deliver: sessions destroyed, role change or deletion result, content disposition, and the reversal path (role can be restored via wp_update_user).

guardrails: wp_delete_user requires an explicit reassign target: refuse to run it bare.
Never offboard user id 1 or the last administrator: the tools will refuse, do not try to work around them.
